caveats: 2021 natural observations: four ponds across two years; pooled counts are descriptive and not independent replicates for inference.
2024 placement experiment started from naturally arboreal nests; five assigned to each placement. These are not counts of natural site choice.

Table 1 hatching date is the paper's operational monitoring endpoint at nest collapse/hatchling movement; discovery-to-endpoint days are not embryonic development time, total foam persistence or duration of abandoned residue.

Three nests have uncertain construction dates (up to four days according to the article); recording dates for nests 34 and 35 precede listed discovery. Keep values as printed, report sensitivity excluding these three.
Hatching percentages are printed rounded; manuscript text differs from table by 0.1 percentage points in a few extrema. No egg-level inference or butterfly outcomes.
